user.title: Govee Local Plus
user.description:
Searches your network for Govee lights. Everything stays local, no Govee account is needed.

Before you continue:
1. Open the light in the Govee Home app > settings and switch on **LAN Control**. Not every model has it.
2. Make sure nothing else listens on UDP port 4002 (the built-in *Govee Light Local* integration or the Govee to MQTT bridge). Only one program can.

Select **Submit** to start the search.

manual.title: Enter the address of the light
manual.description:
No light answered the search. That is common when multicast does not reach the lights (IGMP snooping, Wi-Fi multicast handling, other VLAN). Enter the IP address of your light instead, you find it in your router or in the Govee Home app under the device settings.

If it still is not found: check that LAN Control is on and that UDP 4001, 4002 and 4003 are allowed between Home Assistant and the light.

data_description.device_ips: One address per entry, for example 192.168.1.50

error.cannot_connect: No light answered at this address. Is LAN Control switched on and the address correct?

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Govee Local Plus entry is needed, it covers every light.
abort.port_in_use: UDP port 4002 is already in use. Remove or stop the built-in Govee Light Local integration and the Govee to MQTT bridge, then try again.

add_effect.title: New effect
add_effect.description:
An effect is a fixed colour layout that is painted onto the segments of a light and then shows up in its effect list. {hint}

Give it a name and a background colour for all segments that are not coloured below. Colour areas follow on the next page.

fill.title: Colour area of "{effect}"
fill.description:
Choose a colour and the segments that get it. Segments are numbered from 1 like in the Govee Home app. Write single numbers and ranges, for example `1-3, 7`. {hint}

Tick **Add another colour area** for more. When editing, leave the segments empty to remove this area.

addresses.title: Light addresses
addresses.description: Optional. Lights with an address listed here are asked directly instead of waiting for the multicast search. Use this when a light is not found automatically.

json.title: Effects as JSON
json.description: All effects in one place, handy for backups and sharing. Segments are numbered from 1. {error}

error.name_exists: An effect with this name exists already.

abort.no_fills: The effect has no coloured segments and was not saved.
abort.invalid_effect: The effect could not be saved.
